name: schedule_register
description: Register a new cron-based scheduled task in z-schedule (XXL-Job style distributed scheduler). Use this when the CEO agent needs to automate a recurring job (daily standup, nightly scanner, hourly fetcher, etc). The task is persisted in MySQL and dispatched by the z-schedule-admin on port 8080. Returns the new task's numeric ID. The task will NOT auto-execute until the corresponding executor handler is registered in a z-schedule-executor instance; use schedule_trigger to manually fire it for testing.

jobCron.description: Quartz-compatible cron expression. Examples: '0 0 9 * * ?' (every day 09:00), '0 0 3 * * ?' (every day 03:00), '0 0/10 * * * ?' (every 10 minutes).

jobDesc.description: Human-readable task name. Will be visible in z-schedule-admin dashboard and execution logs.

executorHandler.description: Name of the @JobHandler annotation value in the executor service. Must be unique within the executor group. Example: 'refScannerJobHandler' or 'ceoMorningMeetingHandler'.

executorParam.description: JSON string passed to the executor at runtime. Use this to parameterize the task (e.g. project path, target domain, namespace).

jobGroup.description: Executor group ID. Default 1. Set to 0 to list all groups. Use the group that matches your executor's app name.

executorRouteStrategy.description: How to pick an executor instance when multiple are registered. Default ROUND. Use SHARDING_BROADCAST for parallel fan-out.

executorBlockStrategy.description: What to do if a new trigger fires while the previous run is still going. Default SERIAL_EXECUTION (queue).

executorTimeout.description: Task timeout in seconds. 0 means no timeout. Recommended 600 (10 min) for typical jobs.

executorFailRetryCount.description: How many times to retry on failure. 0 = no retry. Common: 2-3.

author.description: Who registered this task. Use 'ceo-agent' for AI-registered tasks.

alarmEmail.description: Email to notify on failure. Optional.
